demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: We need guidance on safely repairing an existing workflow in self-hosted n8n 2.30.4 , without risking unintended changes.

ease.reason: A beginner can test a repair checklist with operator supplied workflow descriptions; no attached reference supports n8n repair mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants may pay for safer repair preparation; this request establishes no buyer intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week prototype can compare supplied before-and-after workflow descriptions and draft a checklist; safe changes remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed tool could draft a checklist from supplied symptoms and intended changes; a human must verify and apply every change.

evidence.reason: The fresh request names safe repair of an existing self-hosted workflow but gives no repair steps, recurrence or implementation reference.

candidates.reason: Assessed the concrete safe-repair request as a checklist experiment using operator-supplied test descriptions.
